label: Plantinga-style possibility helpers: non-impossibility, incompatible bundles, same-bearer profile
summary:
Target: the #1864 compatibility questions on the route to the actual de re necessary concrete bearer b19ffd92 (and, through GOD_4, STMT-GOD-EXISTS). Lean-only helpers in TruthCore.Modal.NecessaryIfExistent and its Solution, no registered corpus argument or result. (1) absence_of_impossibility_iff_possible: for one fixed frame and proposition, not-box-not-P iff diamond-P, with excluded middle explicit; global excluded middle is stronger than needed (formula-local double-negation elimination suffices, TruthCore.Modal.PossibleImpossibility.LocalClassical); 'not yet proven impossible' is not the antecedent. (2) s5_not_impossible_actual: S5, the boxed conditional box(G -> box G) and F-relative non-impossibility give G at w; reading F as metaphysical accessibility is OPEN (#438). (3) incompatible_bundle_not_possible: two predicates excluding each other at every world and bearer have no accessible joint bearer, whatever further tag is added; P and Q carry no essence marker or respect parameter, so applications must build these in. (4) possible_maximal_profile_same_bearer: an accessible joint instantiation of one fixed bearer's existence-plus-excellence profile gives the same bearer existing and excellent at w and its successors under S5; it is relative to constant-domain semantics with world-relative existence and rigid identity (actualist or counterpart semantics would need an OPEN transworld-identity premise), and the transport is not new (NonlimitingConcreteExistence.necessaryAtOrigin and ActualEuclidean.necessaryAtOrigin give it for one Ontic individual from Euclidean accessibility and reflexivity at w); the new content is carrying the excellence conjunct. The #438 epistemic/metaphysical Bool control is a structural surrogate showing that S5 frame conditions alone do not entail unrestricted transfer from logical joint satisfiability to an accessible witness; it does not show the transfer principle false. Independent semantic challenge (2026-11-23): no P1; seven P2 wording, reuse and status findings repaired in the Lean doc comments and docs/notes/possibility-transfer-438.md. No premise change; nothing attributed to Plantinga.

Lane F (#2103, 2026-11-27, claude). The NecessaryIfExistent (#437) conclusions now carry connection plans. Necessary existence 9a847482 and coverage 306493cd target NecessaryConcreteAt (b19ffd92); impossibility 49b675bf targets NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt (da3facd6) as a prospective rival. Finding: GodExists IsGod is world-free (some g with IsGod g), so instantiating G at it would be degenerate. The possibility premise for that instance already yields a GOD_4 candidate, and the modal machinery would do no work. The informative target is de re actual existence. It needs a case instance of G and a de dicto to de re bridge, because Box G alone allows different GOD_4 satisfiers at different worlds.
blocker: The GOD_4 attribute mapping of the supplied Excellent predicate, and the metaphysical admissibility from the actual standpoint of the particular complete profile's realizing world (a witness-specific transfer principle), both remain OPEN. Next tests: weaken S5 to Euclidean plus reflexivity at w for the same-bearer helper (#1864 item 4) and restate it over Ontic; relate Excellent to the GOD_4 senses.
